name: fzf2
title: fzf2
description: fzf-style fuzzy search over text files
author: alexmking921

preferences.name: fuzzyMatching
preferences.title: Matching
preferences.label: Fuzzy matching (characters in order, not just substrings)
preferences.description: Off = each search term must appear as an exact substring.

preferences.name: highlightMatches
preferences.title: Display
preferences.label: Highlight matched characters (shows a detail pane)
preferences.description: Bold the matching characters in a detail pane on the right.

preferences.name: preferShorterLines
preferences.title: Ranking
preferences.label: Prefer shorter lines when scores tie
preferences.description: Like fzf's length tiebreak: shorter lines rank first when scores are equal.

preferences.name: caseSensitivity
preferences.title: Case Sensitivity
preferences.description: Smart case ignores case unless your query contains an uppercase letter.

commands.name: fzf-ref
commands.title: fzf ref
commands.description: Fuzzy search the universal ref file

commands.name: fzf-workref
commands.title: fzf workref
commands.description: Fuzzy search the work ref file

commands.name: fzf-keyboard-shortcuts
commands.title: fzf keyboard-shortcuts
commands.description: Fuzzy search your keyboard shortcuts file

commands.name: fzf-vscode-shortcuts
commands.title: fzf vscode shortcuts
commands.description: Fuzzy search your VS Code shortcuts file

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
